blocks.text: VALENCIA CITY, Bukidnon — Some 35 years after environmental advocate-priest Neri Lito Satur was ambushed and killed by alleged members of an illegal logging syndicate, Bukidnon remembered his sacrifice on Wednesday, Oct. 14, through province-wide tree planting and solemn memorial rites. Around 800 seedlings of endemic, native, and exotic tree species were planted at the Kaamulan Provincial Nursery inside Kaamulan Park, Malaybalay City. The activity was spearheaded by the Bukidnon Environment and Natural Resources Office (BENRO), joined by uniformed personnel, national government agencies, students, and academic representatives.
